title: LIT live stop (sweep extreme), 1 NQ mini on every trade
question: Owner order 2026-10-18: upsizing and fewer wide stops - do tighter stops or more contracts pay on LIT?
verdict: 1 NQ on a 45-pt median stop risks ~$900 (up to $1,700, cut by the $1,000 daily limit): 2-week fails 30-40%. 2026 H1 (pick) n=80 3.12/wk win 22.5% PF 2.57 net +45,115 ($7,402/mo) DD -6,714 median stop 44.25 pts, 10.0 micros, $865 at risk; eval 2wk 42.2/37.5 1mo 44.5/43.0 pass rate 50.9% median 4.0; 2026 H2 (check) n=40 2.56/wk win 32.5% PF 2.1 net +20,897 ($5,626/mo) DD -4,508 median stop 51.625 pts, 10.0 micros, $865 at risk; eval 2wk 51.3/28.2 1mo 52.6/38.5 pass rate 57.7% median 4.0; 2021-25 reference only n=510 2.38/wk win 17.1% PF 1.13 net +21,712 ($425/mo) DD -26,806 median stop 38.125 pts, 10.0 micros, $718 at risk; eval 2wk 14.1/34.6 1mo 20.1/64.2 pass rate 24.6% median 9.0
notes: tools/lit_tightstop.py (wraps engine/lit.py; stop_mode ext + LIT size == run lit_live trade for trade). Same LIT signals and fills; the stop, entry limit or size changes. MFFU $1,000 soft daily loss modelled; NQ minis at $4.50 a round trip.
method: LIT replay (engine/lit.py run_x, the same code as the live loop engine/lit_live.py): 2026 entries on 1-minute bars, 2021-25 on 5-minute bars (reference); live sizing + weekly stop; costs included
